# Replacements 0.3.2
A clearer icon and a simpler library, with save feedback that appears where you need it.
- New **brb → be right back** icon, set in macOS's San Francisco system font. - Removed the optional Dictionary Words view. New replacements require a shortcut on macOS; existing word-only entries remain visible and exportable. - Save failures now appear inside the add, template, or review form. Your text stays in place, and Refresh Library checks the result before another attempt. - Unsupported word-only changes stop before any batch writes.
41 automated tests passed. Normal native shortcut creation, editing and deletion were verified again with temporary markers, then cleaned up. This universal Apple Silicon/Intel release is Developer ID signed, notarized and stapled, with a signed Sparkle update from GitHub.
macOS 15 or later. Free, MIT licensed, no account or custom sync service.
